map.💡 真厚度 t = h×cosθ（垂直孔）；真面积 A = L×S；体积 V =: 💡 True thickness t = h×cosθ (vertical hole); true area A = L×S; volume V = A×t; horizontal projected area A_h = L×S×cosθ.
map.本计算假定钻孔垂直，斜孔需另行换算: This calculation assumes a vertical borehole; an inclined hole needs separate conversion
map.倾角为真倾角，视倾角需换算: The dip is the true dip; an apparent dip must be converted
map.倾向延伸为沿层面真长度: The dip extent is the true length along the bedding plane
map.体积为地质体积，储量需乘以体重与品位: The volume is a geological volume; the reserve requires multiplying by bulk density and grade
map.📚 深度解析：钻孔真厚度与三维建模体积参数换算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Borehole True Thickness and 3D Modelling Volume Parameter Conversion
map.真厚度换算：由视厚度与地层倾角求真厚度，校正储量体积: True-thickness conversion: derive the true thickness from the apparent thickness and strata dip to correct the reserve volume
map.建模体积：输入走向长、倾向延与真厚度得块段体积与矿石量: Modelling volume: enter the strike length, dip extent and true thickness to get the block volume and ore tonnage
map.投影对比：比较真面积与水平投影面积差异，辅助三维建模精度控制: Projection comparison: compare the true area with the horizontal projected area to aid 3D modelling accuracy control
map.公式：真厚度 t = 视厚度 h × cos(倾角θ)；真面积 A = 走向长: Formula: true thickness t = apparent thickness h × cos(dip θ); true area A = strike length L × dip extent S; volume V = A × t; horizontal projected area Ah = L×S×cosθ; vertical thickness = h×sinθ; ore tonnage Q = V × bulk density D. Dip θ ranges 0-89° (computed locally; units m, t/m³).
map.例：钻孔视厚 h=5m、θ=25°、L=300m、S=200m、D=2.7 t/: Example: borehole apparent thickness h=5 m, θ=25°, L=300 m, S=200 m, D=2.7 t/m³ → t=5×cos25°=4.532 m, A=60000 m², V=60000×4.532=271892 m³ (0.2719 million m³), Ah=54378 m², vertical thickness=2.113 m, Q=271892×2.7=734109 t.
map.视厚度和真厚度差多少？: How much do the apparent and true thicknesses differ?
map.差在 cosθ。倾角越大差异越显著：θ=25° 时真厚约为视厚的 90.6%，θ: The difference lies in cosθ and grows with the dip: at θ=25° the true thickness is about 90.6% of the apparent thickness, and at θ=60° only 50%. For a steeply dipping ore body, mistaking the apparent for the true thickness greatly overestimates the volume.
map.真面积和水平投影面积何时相等？: When are the true area and the horizontal projected area equal?
map.仅当 θ=0（水平矿体）时二者相等。倾角越大 Ah 比 A 越小，三维建模用真面: Only when θ=0 (horizontal ore body). The larger the dip the smaller Ah relative to A; 3D modelling must use the true area to keep the volume correct.
